# Snowball

![Snowball](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/snowball.png)

Heads gains +1 point every flip for the whole run (max +8).

- **Rarity:** Rare
- **Heads chance:** 30%
- **Shop price:** 24 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 1

## Heads
Score 3 points

## Tails
Score 1 point

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade)
